behaviors.behavior: Every DERIVED_SNAPSHOTS path carries an explicit classification; an unclassified one fails a test
The refresh set is exactly the compliance directory (seven); literal and prefix rule agree
Every exclusion is named with a reason; no session-scoped or run-written path can enter
Regeneration reaches a fixpoint; a producer that never settles is refused
ci-security.json is outside the fixpoint claim
A failed pass is not a pass that found nothing (closed success vocabulary)
A failure in ANY pass fails the run, not only the last one
Content floor: an emptied document blocks the refresh
--allow-shrink waives the ratio floor and NAMES the paths it covered
--allow-shrink never waives the empty floor
A path missing from the payload is blocked, not skipped
capture skips a symlink instead of reading through it
ci-security reports class, scan and staleness; unknown is not fresh; never fails the run
A ci-security producer failure never fails the run; a tree-derived one beside it still does
A concurrent append to an append-only input is never destroyed, and the path is reported
A rewritten producer config IS rewound (append-only handling is per path, not per call)
Producer inputs are rewound even when a pass raises
A refusal restores an operator's edit rather than resetting to HEAD
A left-alone producer input reaches the operator in the result
The banner round-trips base= and release=; both absent renders byte-identically to before
The stamp touches markdown only; the two .json members and banner-less files are untouched
A release value cannot forge a second banner line through the substitution, and an unknown escape does not raise
The STAGED bytes are the stamped ones, read back out of the git index
The COMMIT carries the stamp, read from git show <sha>:<rel> rather than the index
release= only on a release delivery; --pr with --release is refused; the version is never read from git
Staging reports only what differed; a failed git add is a refusal, never 'nothing to do'
The evidence pathspec is presence-filtered and names only the seven
The release skill duplicates no evidence path and still commits the release artifacts
The docs-only PR carries ONLY the seven; returns to the starting branch; noop when unchanged; aborts on a moved or unverifiable base; preflight refuses a dirty or behind checkout
The docs-only commit carries the Run-ID trailer the staleness audit recognises
restore_to_head asks whether HEAD carries a path rather than inferring it, and reports what actually moved

Gate remedy: the printed command clears the gate on a merge HEAD; no base and already-on-trunk both print words rather than a wrong --source; the finding survives; run-written offenders never get --worktree
gh pr create itself
behaviors.reason: the one call that reaches GitHub; substituted through _gh_pr_create so everything up to and including the commit IS tested

surface_verification.detail: The real CLI driven end to end against real git repositories: test_refresh_compliance_docs (main(--stage --release) writing and staging, read back out of the git index AND out of the commit), test_compliance_delivery (the on-demand PR protocol, with a stray file and a triage append planted and proven absent from the commit), and test_derived_snapshot_gate_remedy (the printed remedy EXECUTED against a merge HEAD, then the gate re-run).
